page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No margin notes, running head, or page number. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: quam Ebręam, hoc est veram. Nos in notis utramque indicavimus. Si-mul historiam universam, quantum in nobis fuit, revocavimus ad ipsam veritatem, a qua Sulpicius non semel exorbitavit. Quod ea fide ac diligentia fecimus, ut nihil aut parum admodum desiderari possit. Quicquid ejus fit, fruere; & si fructum aliquem inde percipis, age gratias, primum Deo optimo maximo, cui debemus, quicquid habemus: deinde viris honora-tis, quibus haec historia dedicata & in-scripta; quorum favore atq; auxilio ea-dem nunc emendatior & cōmenta-rio auctior ad manus tuas pervenit. Vale & fave lingua.

page.notes: The first word "quam" begins mid-sentence, so the paragraph continues from the previous page. Long s was normalised to plain s throughout, as instructed, so the printed forms "hiftoriam", "univerfam", "ipfam", "femel", "posfit" and "fructum" appear with s. The printed "frudum" reads as "fructum". The printed "cómenta" is read as "cōmenta" with a macron. The printed spacing "innotis" and "innobis" is read as "in notis" and "in nobis". No printing errors were flagged.
